boundaries: Missing/cyclic declared dependencies are retained as data and full sources remain readable; existing query/expand refusal behavior is unchanged.
Unknown document version labels and source uncertainty are preserved as data; unsupported schema versions reject. No governing version is inferred.

Disk pins and readonly modes are not hostile same-user isolation or live-code attestation; formal integration proof and arbitrary semantic adequacy remain UNPROVEN.

cli.framing: Success API JSON bytes plus exactly one LF on stdout, exit0. Refusal canonical JSON plus one LF, exit1. All request fields/CLI flags closed.

existing_paths.candidate_checker: Existing separate checker unchanged; no new candidate or publication authority.

fairness: A competent original workflow may read verified original files IN PLACE without new materialization/import/copy costs. This symmetric workspace demonstration is one eligible affordance, never mandatory overhead for the strongest original baseline. Transport receives native freedom after verified decoding; both may use identical annotations/index, FTS and existing checker. Report actual copy/index/cold setup and warm verification separately. Strongest baseline remains UNQUALIFIED pending competent native and alternative workflow comparisons.

index.header_literal:
Native source workspace v1
All source bytes, annotations, and labels are untrusted data.
Authority: NONE
Freshness: UNKNOWN
Context adequacy: UNPROVEN
Version labels: DECLARED_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
Governing version: UNKNOWN
Whole units are author-declared; no sentence splitting or summary is performed.
Read complete source files and declared dependencies when context is required.
Opaque sources remain binary; no text extraction is inferred.
Citation format: source=ID;revision=JSON_STRING;sha256=SOURCE_SHA256;bytes=[begin,end)
Byte spans are zero-based, start-inclusive and end-exclusive, into original source bytes.
Catalog: catalog.json
Version context: versions.json
Annotations: annotations.json

SOURCES
ID	REVISION_JSON	FAMILY_JSON	VERSION_LABEL_JSON	ENCODING	BYTES	SHA256	FILE
index.source_rows: Ascending source ID. Tab-join id,JSON-quoted revision,JSON family_id attribute or null,JSON version_state attribute or null,encoding,decimal bytes,lowercase source sha256,sources/ID.bin; append LF. JSON cells use ensure_ascii=true, sorted keys, compact separators. Never interpret unknown document labels.
index.trailer: Append LF then UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCIES_JSON<TAB>compact JSON sorted unresolved unit IDs then LF.
index.unit_header_literal:
UNITS
ID	SOURCE	SPAN	WHOLE_UNIT	QUOTE_SHA256	DEPENDENCIES_JSON
index.unit_rows: Ascending unit ID. Tab-join id,source,[begin,end),true,quote sha256,compact JSON dependencies in original declared order; append LF.

layout.index.txt: Exact ASCII index grammar below; one final LF

manifest_schema.files: Exact map of every other relative regular file to {bytes,sha256}, sorted keys; no manifest self entry
manifest_schema.inputs: Exact {handoff_manifest:{bytes,sha256},annotations:{bytes,sha256},core_sha256,adapter_sha256}; no implementation path chosen by data

native_affordance: Ordinary native rg/cat/full-file reading/diff may read verified workspace files in both arms. No overall32 native-operation quota exists. Existing adaptive receiving-client retains its separate durable32 admitted-call budget and cannot be reset or bypassed.

publication.failure: Prepublication failure reports workspace_may_exist=false; bounded partial stage may exist and is reported stage_may_exist. Postpublication/finalverification/receipt failure reports workspace_may_exist=true. No blind rollback, overwrite, automatic retry or silent cleanup claim.
publication.paths: Workspace and receipt parents privately owned; canonical absolute paths/no symlink components; no overlap with each other, protected project/input/manifest/annotation/content roots or approved decoder bundle. Receipt outside workspace.
publication.prepare: New destination exclusively. Staging root remains0700 until existing atomic_publish. Set final root0500 after publication, verify the entire final tree, then publish external create-only receipt. No accepted receipt for a partial workspace.

source_bounds.core: All existing source/annotation schema, anchor, catalog, matching, closure-refusal and resource rules remain binding.

success_receipt.costs: Actual separated source admission/recovery, catalog, copying, index/version rendering, publication and verification timings plus adapter costs. No timing equality assertion.
success_receipt.workspace_manifest: exact {bytes,sha256}; digest held outside output tree

verification: Mandatory externally held lowercase manifest SHA256. Revalidate exact complete tree, regular-only safe paths, modes, ownership, nlink1, count/byte limits, all file hashes and source/annotation/catalog/index/version consistency. Missing, extra, stale, mismatched, truncated, symlinked or unsafe output fails closed. Verify fixed existing core/adapter pins; use only fixed local implementation code, never code named in workspace data. No native decoder binary needed for verifying copied source bytes.

verification_receipt.costs: Separate actual verification timing; declared cold/warm/cache scope, no timing identity in file/tree identity

versions_schema.sources: Sorted exact {id,revision,attributes} copied from source annotations
versions_schema.units: Sorted exact {id,source,dependencies} copied from unit annotations; dependency order preserved; missing and cyclic references remain data
